name: Mazagan Beach & Golf Resort
insider_take: This stunning oceanfront resort sits on Morocco's Atlantic coast where Portuguese colonial history meets modern luxury on 250 hectares of pristine coastline.
whats_special: The resort features Morocco's only links-style golf course designed by Gary Player, stretching along dramatic clifftops with ocean views on 7 holes. El Jadida's UNESCO World Heritage Portuguese City (Mazagan) is just minutes away, showcasing 16th-century fortifications and underground cisterns that inspired Orson Welles' "Othello."
pro_tip: Visit the Portuguese Cistern at sunset when golden light filters through the stone columns, creating magical reflections in the water below.
dont_miss: Explore the ancient ramparts of the Portuguese Fortified City, Morocco's best-preserved example of Renaissance military architecture, then enjoy fresh seafood at the local port where colorful fishing boats return with the day's catch.
pros: Championship 18-hole golf course designed by Gary Player
Direct beachfront location on Atlantic Ocean
Expansive luxury resort with multiple dining venues
Full-service spa and extensive recreational facilities
cons: Large resort property may feel less intimate
Located outside main El Jadida city center
